newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kinder Morgan upped to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kinder Morgan upped to buy.

text.p: -- PaineWebber said analyst Ron Barone upgraded Kinder Morgan Energy Partners LP to buy from neutral.
-- raised earnings estimate to $2.50 per unit from $1.70 for 1997 for the master limited partnership in the business of interstate/intrastate transportation of natural gas liquids.
-- cited increased capacity utilization and profitability of its assets, new management, unit ownership by senior officers, and longer term growth potential.
-- set 12-month target of $53. Units were up 1/2 to 41-5/8 on Thursday.
